user.title: UniFi Access guests
user.description: The access console must be reachable on port 12445. The token needs view:policy, view:visitor and edit:visitor. Calendars are added afterwards on the integration page.

reconfigure.title: Connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the token empty to keep the stored token.

error.policies_unavailable: Access policies could not be loaded. The token needs view:policy, and the console must be reachable on port 12445.

user.title: Add calendar
user.description: Link one calendar to an access policy.

reconfigure.title: Edit calendar
reconfigure.description:
Calendar: {calendar}

Changing the calendar replaces its visitors on the next sync. Visitors of the previous calendar are removed.

abort.policies_unavailable: Access policies could not be loaded. Change the connection and give the token view:policy.

sync.name: Sync guests
sync.description: Reconcile the calendars with UniFi Access visitors now.

download_qr_code.name: Download QR code
download_qr_code.description: Download the door QR code for a visitor and return the saved file.

visitor_id.name: Visitor ID
visitor_id.description: UniFi Access visitor ID. Use this or the calendar fields.

publish.name: Publish for browser download
publish.description: Also store the image at an address a browser can open without login.
